title: Holser Fire ~11 mi west-southwest of us
text:
🔥 Holser Fire — about 20 acres, ~11 mi west-southwest of Tesoro Highlands.
Not an evacuation notice — stay aware, keep phones charged, check your go-bag.
Live map & evacuation status: https://tesorohighlands.com/fire
